verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Datadog's Agent Observability SDK, span tracing, and evaluations, including evaluations tied to spans, traces, or sessions. None of it documents attaching custom metadata (user IDs, session IDs, feature tags) to attribute cost or usage. The Agent Console item covers org-wide AI agent usage and cost, and the community note describes custom search dimensions; both are adjacent features, not per-user/session/feature cost attribution via custom metadata.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attribute cost and usage to users, sessions, and features via custom metadata
